name: @playform/ets-base-dsh
description: The BASE of the ets-* group (@playform/ets-base-dsh): the shared Effect-TS plumbing every ets-* package depends on - the runtime wiring (the Context services, the layer graph and the materialize() runtime assembled for the factory shell), the fiber/stream machinery (the Gate transformer and the pure reducers, the Update envelope) and the shared contract types (the factory's Interface/* structural contracts). Usable outside the harness entirely (the PlayForm ecosystem).
